render_code_commit.confirmation_required: 未解消。RUN6 の歴史的 export に実際に使用された commit の直接記録は未発掘のまま。2026-08-25 に一度 User attestation を根拠として USER_ATTESTED へ確定させたが、同日中の追加 User 裁定（下記 history 参照）により差し戻した——歴史的事実（過去に何が使われたか）は遡って User attest できないため（User の attest 権限は自身の許諾・裁定に及ぶのであり、第三者的な過去の事実確定には及ばない）。RUN9 が今後使用する commit の前方宣言は本欄と独立の `run9_render_code_commit`（status: DECLARED_FOR_RUN9）が担う。今後、RUN6 export の直接記録が発掘された場合のみ本欄を確定させられる。
render_code_commit.inference_basis: This exact revision is the single, repository-wide invariant DiffSinger pin used across run4 through run8 gate_synth/export tooling (dozens of cross-references). The original 2026-08-20 run6 export record (s5_record) does not itself restate the git revision inline, but no evidence anywhere in the repository suggests a different revision was ever used for run5/6/7 rendering or export — the run4 provenance closure record explicitly notes the same absence-of-contrary-evidence reasoning when substituting this pin for an unlogged run4 export (results_s3/run4_provenance_closure_2026-08-23.json). Preserved verbatim (unchanged throughout the 2026-08-25 promotion and reversion below) as the evidentiary record those events reference.

history.event: rev 0.4 実装時、User 裁定「aとbを承認」の b を根拠に status を INFERRED_UNCONFIRMED から USER_ATTESTED へ昇格した（Codex bot review PR #316 第1巡指摘 P2, 866fcc8 が要求していた確定経路のうち、User attestation 経路）。

同日中の追加 User 裁定①により差し戻し: render_code_commit は RUN6 の歴史的 export provenance であり、歴史的事実（過去に何が使われたか）は遡って User attest しない方針が示された。status を INFERRED_UNCONFIRMED へ復元し、User attestation の実体的な意味（RUN9 が今後使用する commit を確定する、という前方宣言）は新設の独立欄 `run9_render_code_commit`（status: DECLARED_FOR_RUN9）へ移した。歴史的事実の不確定性そのものは、この前方宣言の確度に影響しない——両欄は独立である。

render_code_commit.note: The value above was originally an inference, not a directly-logged fact for the 2026-08-20 run6 export specifically — the original run6 export record (results_s5/s5_record_2026-08-20.md) does NOT itself restate the DiffSinger git revision inline anywhere in that record. Codex bot review PR #316 第1巡指摘 (P2, 866fcc8) required this be held as INFERRED_UNCONFIRMED, not PINNED, until either a direct record or explicit User attestation confirmed it. On 2026-08-25 the User provided an attestation and status was briefly promoted to USER_ATTESTED, but a same-day follow-up User ruling reversed that promotion (see the `history` array above): historical facts about what was actually used in the RUN6 export are not retroactively attestable by the User. status is therefore restored to INFERRED_UNCONFIRMED; the substantive content of the User's 2026-08-25 attestation (declaring which commit RUN9 itself will use going forward) now lives in the independent `run9_render_code_commit` field. The underlying inference_basis text is preserved unchanged throughout, not overwritten.

declaration.statement: User 裁定「aとbを承認」の b、および同日の追加 User 裁定①（歴史的 render_code_commit との分離）。RUN9 が今後の render に使用する DiffSinger commit を e2307b1080b00f3999702ce9017cfd75c7f862fe と前方宣言する。

run9_render_code_commit.note: render_code_commit（上記、RUN6 の歴史的 export provenance、INFERRED_UNCONFIRMED のまま）とは独立の欄。値は同じ e2307b1 だが意味論が異なる: render_code_commit は『RUN6 export で実際に何が使われたか』という過去の事実の推定であり未確定のまま、本欄は『RUN9 が今後の render で何を使うか』という前方宣言であり User により確定済み（DECLARED_FOR_RUN9）。歴史的事実の不確定性は前方宣言の確度に影響しない。RUN9_CONTRACT.yaml backbone_runtime_bundle_sha の PINNED 判定は本欄の確定を根拠とする。

run7_not_used.reason: Teacher swap contamination avoidance (User ruling, DESIGN_RUN9_REVISION_0.2.md 改訂5)
run7_not_used.detail: The single intervention between run6 and run7 was a teacher swap (d3synth synthetic teacher retired -> amitaro real-recording teacher). Using the run7 checkpoint as RUN9's Shared Backbone would leave residual effects of that teacher swap baked into the weights, confounding RUN9's own teacher variable (the PJS Performance Lesson introduced by LEARN_PERFORMANCE).

source_distribution.name: NamineRitsu_DiffSinger.zip (リツ公式 DiffSinger 配布)
source_distribution.note: NOT the same zip as the ritsu identity anchor pin (r73_strong_ren0151.zip, 波音リツ強連続音Ver1.5.1, sha256 88c7b3ef... — domains/identity_domain_run9_v1.json anchor_hashes.ritsu). That zip is the raw UTAU voicebank used as the RUN9 Identity anchor; THIS zip is the separate DiffSinger-format canon model distribution consumed at render time via --canon-model-dir. Both are "Ritsu"-branded but serve different roles.

canon_model_assets.canon_model_dir_role: gate_synth.py --canon-model-dir points at this zip's extraction directory. gate_synth.py reads linguistic.onnx / dsdur/dur.onnx / dspitch/pitch.onnx / phonemes.txt from it (gate_synth.py lines ~524-526, 647-650, 2292-2294) — the linguistic front-end, duration predictor, and pitch (variance) predictor that DiffSinger's acoustic model depends on, plus the phoneme vocabulary. These are NOT trained/produced by the run5/6/7 acoustic-model finetuning — they are fixed components bundled with the Ritsu voicebank distribution and are reused unchanged across run5/6/7 renders (confirmed identical across 4 independent probe records below).

linguistic_onnx.note: Byte-identical across all 4 independent probe result files (cross-checked 2026-08-24).

variance_duration_onnx.note: Byte-identical across all 4 independent probe result files.

phonemes_txt.note: Phoneme vocabulary consumed by gate_synth.py canon_phonemes_txt (distinct from run6_bundle/dictionary-ja.txt, which is the grapheme-to-phoneme dictionary pinned separately as phoneme_map_sha256 above).

acoustic_export_companions.note: Co-located in the SAME export output directory as acoustic_onnx_sha256 above (.../out_ritsu/onnx_gate_40000/) — produced by the run6 checkpoint export, not sourced from the canon dir. Included here (rather than as bare top-level fields) because closing the render-flow input set requires them alongside canon_model_assets (Codex bot review PR #316 第2巡指摘, 1e84892).

not_included_by_design.score_module_code: voice_genesis/singer/score.py (sha256 24a6004d...) and phoneme_jp.py (sha256 9cbc7e1d...) are also consumed by the render flow per the same probe records (pins.score_module_sakura / score_module_sakura_dep_phoneme_jp), but these are THIS repository's own source files, not external model assets. completeness_note: Codex bot review PR #316 第2巡指摘 (1e84892, 採用): a runtime bundle that pins only the acoustic checkpoint/ONNX (checkpoint_sha256 / acoustic_onnx_sha256) does NOT close the reproduction input set on its own. The render flow (gate_synth.py) also reads canon model assets via --canon-model-dir (linguistic/duration/pitch predictor ONNX + phoneme vocabulary, from the separate NamineRitsu_DiffSinger.zip canon distribution) and acoustic-export companions co-located with acoustic.onnx (dsconfig.yaml / phonemes.json / speaker embedding). Only with canon_model_assets and acoustic_export_companions included does the consumed-input set close. As of 2026-08-24 this bundle intentionally still left render_code_commit as INFERRED_UNCONFIRMED (see that field) and backbone_runtime_bundle_sha in RUN9_CONTRACT.yaml PENDING as a result — unchanged by this addition. On 2026-08-25 backbone_runtime_bundle_sha was promoted to PINNED, but its justification is now the independent forward-declared `run9_render_code_commit` field (status: DECLARED_FOR_RUN9), not a promotion of the historical `render_code_commit` field — that field remains INFERRED_UNCONFIRMED by design (2026-08-25 User ruling: historical export facts are not retroactively attestable). See `render_code_commit.history` and `run9_render_code_commit` above for the full account.
